title: Position Size Calculator
formula_verified: Position Size = (Account Risk / Trade Risk per Share). Account Risk = Capital × Risk % per trade. Trade Risk = Entry − Stop Loss (long). Example: ₹5L capital, 1% risk = ₹5000 risk; Stop ₹20/share → Buy 250 shares. Max risk should be 1-2% per trade.
